digest.component_or_area: code-review batch runner and finalize metrics
propositions: Pass-1 finder batch in code-review does not emit token usage on its step output, causing the finalize step to exclude it from folded totals
CloudWatch code-review metrics under-report total token consumption because finder-batch usage is absent from batch step outputs
code-review batch_runner.py:130 emits findings/criteria_count/batch_plan but lacks a usage key, diverging from the plan-review pattern established in d52a
finalize.py:169-172 already consumes _usage from step outputs correctly, so the fix is emit-side only and requires no consumer changes
A stale present-tense comment at finalize.py:139-141 documents the gap and must be removed once finder-batch usage is surfaced
